Validate a Study Area vertical target specification

Source: R/study_vertical_reference.R
validate_study_vertical_reference.Rd

Resolves definitions through sf/PROJ without transforming coordinates or raster values. Unknown, local and unresolved declarations are retained as specifications, never certified as compatible with source data or qualified for processing.

validate_study_vertical_reference(
  kind = "unknown",
  definition = "",
  height_type = "unknown",
  elevation_unit = "unknown",
  epoch_status = "unknown",
  coordinate_epoch = NA_real_,
  epoch_evidence = "",
  model_name = "",
  model_version = "",
  model_reference = ""
)

Arguments

kind

vertical_crs, ellipsoidal, declared, local, or unknown.

definition

EPSG/WKT for resolved kinds; name for declared/local kinds.

height_type

orthometric, normal, tidal, ellipsoidal, local, other, or unknown.

elevation_unit

metre, international_foot, us_survey_foot, or unknown.

epoch_status

known, unknown, or not_applicable.

coordinate_epoch

Decimal year when known; otherwise NA_real_.

epoch_evidence

Source establishing the coordinate epoch, required when known.

model_name, model_version, model_reference

Optional intended model metadata.

Value

One-row data frame suitable for the schema-7 vertical_reference table.
